title: BingoMC
description: BingoMC is a Minecraft bingo server. Collect items from your bingo card in survival Minecraft, race friends across Java and Bedrock, and climb the stats leaderboard.
body:
Bingo is a game where you have to collect items that are on your bingo card. To win, you have to arrange the found items in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line on the card. Players can also vote for game settings, such as harder items, a bigger card, or a full card. Ranked members are also able to make custom cards, enable Lockout mode, enable Teams mode, make private games.

A game usually consists of 8 players. Each player is placed at a random location inside the same world. With almost 600 items to play with (in normal mode), the item combinations on a card are virtually endless!
